decided: The settings page, the page of orbit's terminal commands, the page of its workflow commands and the concepts page now say that the user may sign off once per program instead of once per change, when that is asked, and that nothing waits at a change's archive then.
alternatives: describe the program's sign-off only on the settings page
why: A user who sets the program sign-off meets it in the architect session, so the pages that describe that session and the program say what it asks.
